definitions.PROPAGATION: A resolved streamer head advances without a resolved collision, attachment, or bridge event.
definitions.HEAD_INTERACTION: Two or more resolved head regions interact but collision is not yet established.
definitions.STREAMER_COLLISION: Opposing or converging streamer-head regions form a resolved collision ROI.
definitions.ELECTRODE_ATTACHMENT: A resolved streamer/channel region attaches to an electrode boundary.
definitions.BRIDGING: A conductive path connects the designated electrodes according to the producing solver's declared bridge criterion.
definitions.UNRESOLVED: Topology cannot be assigned from available spatial or temporal resolution.

eta_0.definition: Pre-event electric-field magnitude in the declared event ROI divided by Ek.
eta_0.source: streamer field state plus event ROI and declared pre-event time
eta_0.computation: E0_event_region_V_m / Ek_V_m using the recorded ROI statistic
eta_0.applicability: all topologies when E0, Ek, ROI, time, and ROI statistic are resolved

eta_peak.definition: Maximum resolved electric-field magnitude over the event ROI and event interval divided by Ek.
eta_peak.source: streamer field state in event ROI

nu_i.definition: Local electron impact-ionization frequency for the declared ROI statistic.
nu_i.source: existing reaction/transport output; no ReactionModel change is authorized
nu_i.computation: producer-declared ionization frequency evaluated from the frozen model state
nu_i.applicability: only where local gas state and ionization-frequency provenance are available

ne_m_3.definition: Electron number density in the declared event ROI statistic.
ne_m_3.applicability: resolved streamer cells in the event ROI

mu_e_m2_V_s.definition: Electron mobility consistent with the frozen transport model and local state.
mu_e_m2_V_s.computation: no new mobility model is introduced by this contract

sigma_e_S_m.applicability: electron-dominated local conductivity approximation with declared ROI statistic

tau_M_s.definition: Candidate Maxwell relaxation timescale from electron conductivity.

Pi_RF.definition: Candidate diagnostic ratio comparing Maxwell relaxation and impact-ionization timescales.
Pi_RF.applicability: only when both timescales use a consistent ROI/time statistic

dMdt_pulse_width_s.definition: Full width of the main |dM/dt| event pulse at peak/e for the Koile-compatible profile.
dMdt_pulse_width_s.computation: threshold-crossing width with interpolation only between resolved samples
dMdt_pulse_width_s.applicability: single resolved main pulse with adequate temporal sampling

f3dB_Hz.definition: Frequency where ESD first falls 3 dB below its declared reference-frequency value.
f3dB_Hz.computation: first high-frequency threshold crossing relative to reference_frequency_Hz
f3dB_Hz.applicability: resolved spectrum containing reference and crossing frequencies

f10dB_Hz.definition: Frequency where ESD first falls 10 dB below its declared reference-frequency value.
f10dB_Hz.computation: first high-frequency threshold crossing relative to reference_frequency_Hz
f10dB_Hz.applicability: resolved spectrum containing reference and crossing frequencies

spectral_slope_dB_decade.definition: Linear-fit slope of ESD in dB versus log10 frequency over a recorded fit band.
spectral_slope_dB_decade.source: processed ESD and explicit fit band
spectral_slope_dB_decade.computation: least-squares slope; fit limits and sample count are mandatory metadata
spectral_slope_dB_decade.applicability: positive finite ESD with a resolved fit band

event_start_s.definition: Declared start of the event interval.

event_peak_s.definition: Time of the main resolved |dM/dt| event peak.

event_end_s.definition: Declared end of the event interval.

event_time_resolution_s.definition: Largest effective original output interval contributing to the event estimate.

event_sampling_quality.definition: Temporal support class based on original effective samples per pulse width.
event_sampling_quality.computation: RESOLVED_PREFERRED if >=10; RESOLVED_MINIMUM if >=5; otherwise NOT_RESOLVED_TEMPORAL_RESOLUTION

trust_status.source: input, temporal, processing, and spectral gates
